# DESIGN.md

## Visual world
A quiet utility app. Deep green as the single action color, warm neutrals
behind it, one serif for display and a grotesque for everything else.

## Color
| Role | Value |
|---|---|
| primary | #1B7F5C |
| surface | #FBFAF8 |
| onSurface | #14171A |
| error | #B3261E |

## Type
Font: Söhne
Display font: Fraunces

Type ramp — font size: 36, 24, 18, 16, 13

## Spacing and shape
Spacing steps: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48
Corner radius: 4, 8, 12
